description: All content sections below the hero (design §2 sections 3-8): About, Skills, Experience 'flight log', Missions 'mission log' (with interactive inline-expand cards), Gallery of placeholder aerial tiles, and the Contact COMMS form with client-side validation state. Depends on FEAT-001 (UI primitives, portfolio.js data, validateContact, useReducedMotion). Independent of FEAT-002 (the hero subsystem) — these sections render regardless of the 3D path. Each section is a <section id aria-labelledby> consuming only portfolio.js data.
steps: Create src/components/sections/About.jsx (#about): two columns — a framed HudFrame 'operator profile' card (avatar placeholder block + mono spec sheet ROLE/BASE/STATUS/FLIGHT HOURS) and bio prose (max-w-65ch, text-hud-mid) + a quick-stats strip from about.stats; Framer Motion reveal gated by useReducedMotion; <h2> via SectionHeading with aria-labelledby.

Create src/components/sections/Skills.jsx (#skills): a responsive grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) of HudCard, one per skillGroup, each with a mono group header and its skills rendered via SignalBars (level 0..5) and/or Tag; data from skillGroups.

Create src/components/sections/Experience.jsx (#experience): a 'Flight Log' vertical timeline — central cyan spine with status-dot node markers; each entry a .glass card with mono SORTIE id/role/org/dates and highlight bullets; alternating sides at >=md, single column <md; entries reveal sequentially (gated by useReducedMotion). Data from experience (status current|past).

Create src/components/sections/Gallery.jsx (#gallery): a uniform grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 of aspect-[4/3] AerialTile elements (define AerialTile in this file): distinct CSS gradient + topographic inline-SVG lines + a coordinate caption overlay revealed on hover; image:null -> gradient placeholder with alt="", real image path -> alt from data. Data from gallery.

Create src/components/sections/Missions.jsx (#missions) with a MissionCard: responsive grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3; each card = gradient aerial placeholder + grid/CornerBrackets overlay, 'MISSION //' id, title, StatusChip, objective, Tag row, and a real <button aria-expanded> 'VIEW LOG' that inline-expands a collapsible region holding the full objective + tech list (local useState per card). CLASSIFIED cards render the button aria-disabled reading 'ACCESS DENIED' with redacted (reduced-opacity, hud.dim + lock glyph) styling and do not expand. Data from projects.

Create src/components/sections/Contact.jsx (#contact): left COMMS form (name/email/message) with HUD-styled inputs and controlled state; submit handler calls validateContact and blocks the simulated send unless valid; each field sets aria-invalid only when errors[field] exists and aria-describedby points at its error text; on invalid, focus moves to the first errored field; on valid, show a role="status" aria-live="polite" success state ('SIGNAL SENT'); focus-visible:ring-hud-cyan on inputs. Right column = social/comms rows from contact.socials with status dots. No network request.
Run `npm run build`; fix any errors before marking complete.
acceptance_criteria: On `npm run dev`, About/Skills/Experience/Gallery/Missions/Contact each render entirely from src/data/portfolio.js with no hardcoded content strings, responsive at mobile and desktop widths, and no broken images (placeholders are CSS gradient / inline SVG).
MissionCard VIEW LOG expands/collapses via keyboard (button aria-expanded toggles a region); CLASSIFIED cards show a disabled 'ACCESS DENIED' affordance that does not expand.

Contact form blocks an invalid submit, shows per-field errors with aria-invalid/aria-describedby, moves focus to the first errored field, and on valid input shows the aria-live success state; no network request is made.
Reveal animations run once and are instant under prefers-reduced-motion.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm exit 0.

Run `npm run dev`; at mobile and desktop widths verify each section renders from data with intact placeholders and no console errors; keyboard-test MissionCard expand/collapse and the CLASSIFIED disabled state; submit the contact form empty (expect blocked + errors + focus move) then valid (expect SIGNAL SENT); toggle prefers-reduced-motion and confirm reveals are instant.

The browser-only smoke checks (keyboard expand/collapse, focus-move on invalid submit, reduced-motion instant reveals) could not be run headlessly — the sandbox blocks starting dev/preview (same constraint FEAT-001/002 recorded); build + compiled-CSS inspection stand in for them. Each section is a self-contained default-export

-heading" matching the SectionHeading id. Section ids match data.nav ids exactly: about, skills, experience, missions, gallery, contact. Section shell convention used by all six: `relative mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-24 md:py-32`. Kicker numbering: 01 About, 02 Skills, 03 Flight Log (Experience), 04 Mission Log (Missions), 05 Gallery, 06 Comms (Contact).
